assertions.title: Outreach updates when scoring changes

steps.action: Navigate to xAI brief page and note initial Outreach section state
steps.observed: Outreach section shows 3 contacts: Toby Pohlen (A, 91/100), Tony Cheema (A, 86/100), Saurabh Kumar (B, 83/100) — matching top 3 from Scoring section
Scoring: Toby Pohlen A 91, Tony Cheema A 86, Saurabh Kumar B 83, Jamie Michaels B 80, Andrew Mi B 74

steps.action: Click Lead Scoring 'Rerun' button to rescore all contacts
steps.observed: Scoring button changed to 'Scoring...' (disabled), contacts showed NaN/100 during scoring, then populated with new scores

steps.action: Wait for scoring to complete (~30 seconds)
steps.expected: Scoring section returns to success state with updated scores
steps.observed: Scoring completed with new scores: Toby Pohlen A 92, Tony Cheema A 87, Jamie Michaels A 86, Saurabh Kumar B 82, Andrew Mi B 75. Order changed — Jamie Michaels moved from #4 to #3.

steps.action: Check Outreach section without reload for updated ranking
steps.expected: Outreach reflects new top 3: Toby Pohlen (92), Tony Cheema (87), Jamie Michaels (86)
steps.observed: Outreach still shows OLD data: Toby Pohlen (91/100), Tony Cheema (86/100), Saurabh Kumar (83/100). Scores are stale and ranking does not reflect updated scoring. Jamie Michaels not shown despite being new #3.

steps.action: Reload page and check Outreach again
steps.expected: After reload, Outreach should reflect updated scores
steps.observed: After page reload, Outreach correctly shows: Toby Pohlen (A, 92/100), Tony Cheema (A, 87/100), Jamie Michaels (A, 86/100). Scores and ranking now match the updated scoring.

assertions.issues: The Outreach section does not automatically update after scoring rerun. After rescoring, the Outreach section continues to display stale scores and the old contact ranking (Saurabh Kumar #3 with 83/100 instead of Jamie Michaels #3 with 86/100). A full page reload is required to see the updated outreach recommendations. The scoring rerun's revalidatePath/server action does not propagate updated scores to the Outreach section's client-side state.

frictions.description: For VAL-CROSS-006, there is no way to naturally trigger an API error in the app — had to use agent-browser network route abort to simulate a failure
frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser network route with --abort flag to block /api/reports/generate, then removed the block before clicking Retry

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 1 passed (VAL-CROSS-006: error recovery via section retry works correctly with error→retry→success flow and scoped API calls), 1 failed (VAL-CROSS-007: outreach section does not automatically update when scoring changes — requires page reload to reflect new rankings and scores)
